PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarker data reported to confirm downstream biology changes from VEGF inhibition or chemotherapy mechanisms. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint (DFS) clearly missed with p=0.2024. Both bevacizumab-containing arms (folfox4_bv and xelox_bv) failed while the control FOLFOX4 arm succeeded, indicating the addition of bevacizumab did not improve outcomes. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. The enrolled population was stage II/III colon cancer patients in the adjuvant setting. 5. CONFOUNDERS: The trial appears adequately powered (n=3451) with appropriate duration (156.4 weeks follow-up). Safety profile shows expected bevacizumab-related toxicities but no dose-limiting issues that would prevent adequate exposure. The failure appears to be mechanistic - bevacizumab addition to standard chemotherapy did not provide benefit in the adjuvant colorectal cancer setting.
